standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-compact stacks have affine smooth presentations
Affine refinement of fppf and etale coverings
qqs permanence of fibre products of stacks

core_obligations: Apply the colim-global lemma via its remark to B = objects of X_tau lying over affine schemes; verify (1): qc of X gives a surjective smooth x: U -> X with U affine, h_x^# -> * surjective (proof lines 2617-2631).
Verify (2): coverings are fppf/etale, refined by finite affine coverings (Topologies lemmas) (proof lines 2632-2636).

Verify (3): the product h_x^# x h_{x'}^# is the sheaf of the algebraic space W = U x_X U', quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness, covered surjectively-etale by an affine U'' giving h_{x''}^# -> product surjective (proof lines 2637-2651).
Verify (4): the equalizer of two morphisms over X is represented by the equalizer scheme, affine over X, hence in B (proof lines 2652-2657).
proof_roadmap: Set up the colim-global criterion on the affine basis B.
Verify the four covering and finiteness conditions in turn.
difficulty_reason: Hypothesis-verification proof: the colim-global-sections criterion of Cohomology on Sites is applied to the site X_tau with the full subcategory of objects lying over affine schemes, and each of the four conditions is verified in turn using quasi-compactness (surjective smooth cover by an affine), fppf/etale coverings refined by finite affine coverings, quasi-separatedness (the fibre product algebraic space is quasi-compact, covered by an affine), and affine equalizers.
